title: Add ability to store ESP SAs in PCAPNG DSB
description:
Similar to what we do with TLS keys for example.
It saves the esp_sa file entries used in a Decryption Secrets Block
and load them in the ESP UAT when opening the file.

Yes.
Note that this may require that the list of fields in the UAT be frozen, so that the DSB in question will always be able to be read by all programs that include code to read it.
We do have some code that applies default values when a field is missing, so it should be safe
Then the description in the I-D should indicate, for each of the columns for which a default value is applied, what the default value is when missing.
Sorry i do not know what you mean by I-D, but this is achieved in the code using uat_set_default_values() function.

> Sorry i do not know what you mean by I-D

Internet-Draft; "the I-D" being [draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcapng/).

> but this is achieved in the code using uat_set_default_values() function

The default values for the columns must be put into the I-D - or, alternatively, the DSB should be forced not to have missing fields.

There is one small drawback: as the ESP records in the DSB is used to populate the ESP dissector UAT, when you close the current capture file and open a new one the UAT entries remain loaded. You have to close Wireshark and reopen it to clear it (or manually remove them using the UAT dialog). Also if you open the ESP UAT dialog and click save, the content will be written on the disk in the esp_sa file.

I do not know if this is problematic, but it is worth mentioning it.
